decisions.prompt: I'm long NHX here and adding on any dip under forty. This is my highest-conviction name for the quarter.

I bought the dip in the semis basket today. Full size, no hedge, and I'm comfortable holding through earnings.
Staying overweight energy. I've said it for weeks and nothing in this print changes my mind.
I trimmed half of my gold miners into the rip. Locking gains, still hold a starter.
Short the homebuilders. That's where my book is positioned and I'm sizing it up into the meeting.
I'm flat everything into the number. No positions, no exposure, watching from the sideline by choice.
Been accumulating the uranium names all month and I'll keep buying weakness. Conviction is high.
I sold my airlines yesterday and I'm not looking back. Wrong thesis, cut it, moving on.
If VLR reclaims the 200-day on volume, I'll start a position. Until then I do nothing.
Should the jobs number come in soft, I'd add to my rate-cut trades. It hasn't yet, so no move.
As long as crude holds above seventy, the tanker thesis stays alive for me. Lose it and I'm out.
I'll get bullish the moment this downtrend line breaks. Not before, not on hope.
When the VIX finally cracks under fifteen I'll redeploy the cash pile. We're not there.
Provided the guidance isn't cut, I stay in. A cut and I reassess the whole position overnight.
If they lose that support shelf I flip short in a heartbeat. Watching it tick by tick.
Only if the spread tightens back under two hundred would I touch the high-yield names again.
